text.tspan: One shared workspace for approved stock across all deinstall jobs.
Missing Location does not hide stock
Return to stock makes units visible in Inventory, even without a Location. Missing placement stays highlighted until completed.
North depot · Storage starts from the last deinstall FZ and remains editable. Set a destination storage and optional Location for each line.
On return: 1 on hand / 1 reserved / 0 available
Visible in Inventory; Location still needed
3 deinstall jobs · 6 pcs · 4 pcs awaiting stock return · 2 pcs already in Inventory
Return to stock records the selected units in Inventory. Existing installation reservations are retained; stock approval is never inferred from a reservation.
Visible in Inventory · 2 on hand / 0 reserved / 2 available. Location is not set and remains highlighted here and in Inventory.
